pairs: Accesseruntque principes familiarum Levi ad Eleazarum sacerdotem,
And the leaders of the families of Levi approached Eleazar, the priest,
and Joshua, the son of Nun,
et ad duces cognationum per singulas tribus filiorum Israël:
and the rulers of the extended families of each of the tribes of the sons of Israel.
locutique sunt ad eos in Silo terræ Chanaan,
And they spoke to them at Shiloh, in the land of Canaan,
“The Lord instructed, by the hand of Moses,
ut darentur nobis urbes ad habitandum,
that cities should be given to us as habitations,
et suburbana earum ad alenda jumenta.
with their suburbs to nourish our cattle.”
Dederuntque filii Israël de possessionibus suis juxta imperium Domini,
And so the sons of Israel gave cities and their suburbs from their possessions,
in accord with the order of the Lord.
Egressaque est sors in familiam Caath filiorum Aaron sacerdotis,
And the lot went out for the family of Kohath,
from the tribes of Judah and Simeon and Benjamin:
And to the remainder of the sons of Kohath,
to the Levites who were left over,
from the tribes of Ephraim and Dan,
and from the one half tribe of Manasseh,
Porro filii Gerson egressa est sors,
And next the lot went out to the sons of Gershon,
ut acciperent de tribubus Issachar et Aser et Nephthali,
so that they would receive, from the tribes of Issachar and Asher and Naphtali,
and from the one half tribe of Manasseh at Bashan:
Et filiis Merari per cognationes suas de tribubus Ruben et Gad et Zabulon urbes duodecim.
And to the sons of Merari, by their families, from the tribes of Reuben and Gad and Zebulun, there went twelve cities.
Dederuntque filii Israël Levitis civitates et suburbana earum,
And so the sons of Israel gave cities and their suburbs to the Levites,
sicut præcepit Dominus per manum Moysi,
just as the Lord instructed by the hand of Moses,
From the tribes of the sons of Judah and Simeon,
filiis Aaron per familias Caath Levitici generis (prima enim sors illis egressa est),
to the sons of Aaron, of the families of Kohath of the stock of Levi, (for the first lot went out for them,)
the city of Arba, the father of Anak,
in monte Juda, et suburbana ejus per circuitum.
on the mountain of Judah, and its surrounding suburbs.
Agros vero et villas ejus dederat Caleb filio Jephone ad possidendum.
Yet truly, the fields and its villages he had given to Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, as a possession.
Dedit ergo filiis Aaron sacerdotis Hebron confugii civitatem,
Therefore, he gave to the sons of Aaron the priest, Hebron as a city of refuge,
Then, from the tribe of the sons of Benjamin,
Omnes simul civitates filiorum Aaron sacerdotis,
All the cities together of the sons of Aaron, the priest,
Reliquis vero per familias filiorum Caath Levitici generis,
Yet truly, the remainder of the families of the sons of Kohath, of the stock of Levi,
from the tribe of Ephraim, Shechem,
Sichem cum suburbanis suis in monte Ephraim,
one of the cities of refuge, with its suburbs, on mount Ephraim,
and from the tribe of Dan,
from the one half tribe of Manasseh,
datæ sunt filiis Caath inferioris gradus.
these were given to the sons of Kohath, of the lesser degree.
Filiis quoque Gerson Levitici generis dedit de dimidia tribu Manasse confugii civitates, Gaulon in Basan, et Bosram, cum suburbanis suis, civitates duas.
Likewise, to the sons of Gershon, of the stock of Levi, from the one half tribe of Manasseh, went Golan in Bashan, one of the cities of refuge, and Bosra, with their suburbs, two cities;
also, from the tribe of Issachar,
De tribu quoque Nephthali civitates confugii,
likewise, from the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee,
one of the cities of refuge,
All the cities of the families of Gershon were thirteen,
Filiis autem Merari Levitis inferioris gradus per familias suas data est de tribu Zabulon, Jecnam, et Cartha
Then, to the sons of Merari, Levites of the lesser degree, by their families, were given, from the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam and Kartah,
De tribu Ruben ultra Jordanem contra Jericho civitates refugii,
from the tribe of Reuben, beyond the Jordan, opposite Jericho,
Misor et Jaser et Jethson et Mephaath,
one of the cities of refuge, Misor and Jazer,
and Jethson and Mephaath, four cities with their suburbs;
from the tribe of Gad, Ramoth of Gilead,
one of the cities of refuge,
et Manaim et Hesebon et Jazer,
and Mahanaim and Heshbon and Jazer,
Omnes urbes filiorum Merari per familias
All the cities of the sons of Merari,
by their families and extended families,
Itaque civitates universæ Levitarum in medio possessionis filiorum Israël fuerunt quadraginta octo
And so all the cities of the Levites, in the midst of the possession of the sons of Israel, were forty-eight,
Deditque Dominus Deus Israëli omnem terram, quam traditurum se patribus eorum juraverat:
And the Lord God gave to Israel all the land that he had sworn he would deliver to their fathers.
Dataque est ab eo pax in omnes per circuitum nationes:
And he gave them peace with all the surrounding nations.
nullusque eis hostium resistere ausus est,
And none of their enemies dared to stand against them;
sed cuncti in eorum ditionem redacti sunt.
instead, they were brought under their sovereignty.
quod illis præstiturum se esse promiserat,
not so much as one word that he had promised to provide for them was left empty;
